items.name: EGR stepping-motor position
items.meaning: EGR valve stepping-motor position; Mazda procedures use it both for monitoring and controlled simulation. Diagnostic use: At idle expected to be zero in the cited L3 procedure; should increase under the specified loaded acceleration test and return to zero when stopped. Caveat: Simulation can stall the engine. Do not execute until the exact command and safety workflow are verified. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Fuel pump relay command
items.meaning: Fuel-pump relay simulation/control item. Diagnostic use: Fuel-delivery actuator test. Caveat: Not a passive sensor read. Keep executable disabled until Mazda command sequence, prerequisites, timeout and recovery are verified. Decode status: simulation_only.

items.name: Injector No. 1 simulation command
items.meaning: Individual cylinder 1 injector control/simulation item. Diagnostic use: Cylinder contribution and injector actuator testing. Caveat: Not a passive measurement. Automatic execution is prohibited. Decode status: simulation_only.

items.name: Injector No. 2 simulation command
items.meaning: Individual cylinder 2 injector control/simulation item. Diagnostic use: Cylinder contribution and injector actuator testing. Caveat: Not a passive measurement. Automatic execution is prohibited. Decode status: simulation_only.

items.name: Injector No. 3 simulation command
items.meaning: Individual cylinder 3 injector control/simulation item. Diagnostic use: Cylinder contribution and injector actuator testing. Caveat: Not a passive measurement. Automatic execution is prohibited. Decode status: simulation_only.

items.name: Injector No. 4 simulation command
items.meaning: Individual cylinder 4 injector control/simulation item. Diagnostic use: Cylinder contribution and injector actuator testing. Caveat: Not a passive measurement. Automatic execution is prohibited. Decode status: simulation_only.

items.name: VVT response to OCV battery-voltage test
items.formula: warm idle + battery voltage to OCV -> engine idles roughly or stalls
items.meaning: Human-guided service test only; do not automate through OBD.

items.name: FN4A-EL oil pressure switch state in D
items.formula: engine running + brake firmly depressed + selector D -> continuity to ground
items.meaning: Direct Mazda 5 2007 loaded on-vehicle test; human-guided only.

items.name: Shift solenoid A / SS1 command
items.meaning: PCM command for shift solenoid A. Diagnostic use: Diagnose commanded hydraulic shift state. Caveat: Can be actively simulated. Never execute without verified command, P/N prerequisites, timeout and recovery. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Shift solenoid B / SS2 command
items.meaning: PCM command for shift solenoid B. Diagnostic use: Diagnose commanded hydraulic shift state. Caveat: Can be actively simulated. Keep execution disabled. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Shift solenoid C / SS3 command
items.meaning: PCM command for shift solenoid C. Diagnostic use: Diagnose commanded hydraulic shift state. Caveat: Can be actively simulated. Keep execution disabled. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Shift solenoid D / SS4 command
items.meaning: PCM command for shift solenoid D. Diagnostic use: Check expected solenoid state by commanded gear. Caveat: Can be actively simulated. Keep execution disabled. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Shift solenoid E / SS5 command
items.meaning: PCM command for shift solenoid E / TCC-related state. Diagnostic use: Torque-converter clutch command diagnosis. Caveat: Can be actively simulated. Keep execution disabled. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: A/C relay / compressor control status
items.meaning: PCM A/C compressor relay/control status used by Mazda M-MDS; the same label is also listed among simulation items. Diagnostic use: Correlate A/C load requests with idle control, generator load and fan operation. Caveat: Exact meaning can be relay status or compressor cycling control depending calibration; no proprietary request identifier is present in the source. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Cooling fan commanded duty
items.meaning: PCM cooling-fan duty command. Diagnostic use: Fan-control and overheating diagnosis. Caveat: Listed as an M-MDS simulation item; it must not be automatically executed without a verified command and safety gate. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: EVAP purge solenoid commanded duty
items.meaning: PCM purge-control solenoid duty command. Diagnostic use: EVAP purge diagnosis and identifying purge-related mixture disturbances. Caveat: SAE 012E reports commanded purge and is a useful fallback, but exact Mazda simulation/monitor transport is unknown. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Electronic throttle desired position
items.meaning: PCM commanded/desired electronic throttle position. Diagnostic use: Control-error analysis: desired versus actual throttle. Caveat: No standardized equivalent and no confirmed Mazda request or formula. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Front A/F sensor heater control
items.meaning: Bank 1 sensor 1 air/fuel sensor heater control. Diagnostic use: Front lambda-sensor warm-up and heater diagnosis. Caveat: Can be a simulation item; encoding and whether duty or binary state is displayed depend on calibration. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Fuel injector pulse width / duration
items.meaning: PCM injector-duration value or simulation target for the primary injection channel. Diagnostic use: Compare commanded fueling under gasoline versus LPG and correlate with trims and lambda. Caveat: The direct list identifies the item but does not provide request, byte layout or time-unit scaling. Decode status: defined_no_transport. Same-era MZR references display this value in milliseconds; see condition-specific expectations.

items.name: Generator desired voltage
items.meaning: PCM charging-system target voltage. Diagnostic use: Compare charging target with VPWR and generator response. Caveat: No proprietary request or formula is available. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Generator field coil control duty
items.meaning: PCM commanded generator field-current duty. Diagnostic use: Charging-system diagnosis; duty should react to electrical load and charging demand. Caveat: Do not equate directly with alternator output voltage. Proprietary transport and byte scaling remain unknown. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Intake manifold runner / variable tumble control
items.meaning: PCM variable tumble/intake-runner control state or command. Diagnostic use: Air-path and low-speed torque diagnosis. Caveat: Listed as a simulation item; exact Mazda transport and displayed representation are unknown. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Rear HO2S heater control
items.meaning: Bank 1 sensor 2 oxygen-sensor heater control. Diagnostic use: Rear sensor readiness and catalyst-monitor diagnosis. Caveat: Can be a simulation item; proprietary encoding is unknown. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Target engine speed
items.meaning: PCM desired/target engine speed. Diagnostic use: Compare desired idle speed with actual RPM to distinguish control demand from mechanical inability to hold idle. Caveat: Actual RPM can be read through SAE 010C, but desired RPM is Mazda-specific and has no confirmed transport. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Variable intake-air control valve
items.meaning: PCM variable intake-air valve control state or command. Diagnostic use: Intake tuning and airflow plausibility. Caveat: Listed as a simulation item; do not execute without verified protocol and safety conditions. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Variable valve timing oil-control-valve duty
items.meaning: PCM duty command to the bank 1 VVT oil control valve. Diagnostic use: VVT actuation diagnosis; compare with desired and actual valve timing when those channels become available. Caveat: Listed as an M-MDS simulation item. No proprietary request or scaling has been confirmed. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Automatic transmission fluid temperature
items.meaning: ATF temperature calculated from the transmission-fluid-temperature sensor. Diagnostic use: Overheat protection, shift-quality and warm-up diagnosis. Caveat: SAE engine-oil temperature PID is not a substitute. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Distance since DTC P1712 was last recorded
items.meaning: Diagnostic history distance counter associated with DTC P1712. Diagnostic use: Determine how recently the wheel-speed-difference diagnostic event occurred. Caveat: Availability and exact reset behavior depend on PCM calibration. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Distance since maximum left/right wheel-speed difference event
items.meaning: Distance traveled after the stored maximum drive-wheel speed difference event. Diagnostic use: Context for differential wheel-speed events and traction-related diagnostics. Caveat: No proprietary request identifier is available. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Distance traveled after high ATF-temperature mode operation
items.meaning: Distance accumulated after operation of high ATF-temperature protection mode. Diagnostic use: Estimate recency/use after an overheating event. Caveat: Reset behavior and whether value is since first or last event require vehicle verification. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Engine coolant temperature input used by transmission control
items.meaning: Coolant temperature shared from engine control and used in transmission strategy. Diagnostic use: Warm-up-state and shift-strategy context. Caveat: The physical input can be read through standard OBD; the internal TCM copy may update at a different rate. Decode status: exact_standard_alias.

items.name: Engine speed input used by transmission control
items.meaning: Engine speed used for shift and pressure control. Diagnostic use: Calculate converter/input slip and contextualize pressure commands. Caveat: Standard OBD provides the same physical engine-speed signal. Decode status: exact_standard_alias.

items.name: Gear commanded by control module
items.meaning: Current commanded forward gear. Diagnostic use: Compare commanded gear with TSS/OSS ratio and shift-solenoid states. Caveat: Commanded gear is not proof that the hydraulic/mechanical shift completed. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: High ATF-temperature mode activation count
items.meaning: Number of times high-oil-temperature protection mode operated; source threshold is approximately 130 deg C. Diagnostic use: Detect historical transmission overheating. Caveat: Counter reset behavior is not specified. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Input/turbine shaft speed
items.meaning: Transmission input/turbine rotational speed. Diagnostic use: Converter slip, gear-ratio and clutch diagnosis. Caveat: At P the cited reference tracks engine speed with a small difference; in D while stopped it should be zero. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Input/turbine speed sensor resistance temperature scope
items.meaning: Temperature scope stated by Mazda for the 250-600 ohm resistance specification.

items.name: Input/turbine speed sensor resistance — FN4A-EL
items.meaning: Direct Mazda 5 2007 automatic-transaxle sensor; specified across ATF -40 to 160 C.

items.name: Manual downshift switch state
items.meaning: Selector lever downshift request switch. Diagnostic use: Diagnose manual-mode downshift complaints. Caveat: No proprietary enum encoding is available. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Manual upshift switch state
items.meaning: Selector lever upshift request switch. Diagnostic use: Diagnose manual-mode upshift complaints. Caveat: No proprietary enum encoding is available. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Manual-mode selector switch state
items.meaning: Selector lever M-position switch condition. Diagnostic use: Diagnose inability to enter manual shift mode. Caveat: No proprietary encoding is available. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Maximum left/right drive-wheel rotation-speed difference
items.meaning: Stored maximum rotation-speed difference between drive wheels. Diagnostic use: Identify abnormal wheel-speed difference context. Caveat: Event retention and reset behavior are calibration-dependent. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Output shaft speed
items.meaning: Transmission output-shaft rotational speed. Diagnostic use: Compare with TSS, commanded gear and vehicle speed to detect ratio/slip faults. Caveat: Do not substitute vehicle speed without tire/final-drive conversion. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: PCM supply / vehicle power voltage
items.meaning: Power-supply voltage available to the control module. Diagnostic use: Rule out low-voltage-induced shift and solenoid faults. Caveat: Expected to follow battery B+ under normal conditions. Decode status: exact_standard_alias.

items.name: Target transmission line pressure
items.meaning: PCM target hydraulic line pressure. Diagnostic use: Compare hydraulic pressure demand across load and engine-speed conditions. Caveat: Target pressure is calculated demand, not measured line pressure. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Transmission fluid temperature sensor voltage
items.meaning: Raw voltage from the TFT thermistor circuit. Diagnostic use: Cross-check decoded TFT and detect open/short or implausible thermistor behavior. Caveat: Voltage is nonlinear with temperature; exact full transfer curve is not yet stored. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Transmission range position
items.meaning: Decoded selector/range position. In M position the cited table reports D for the range channel. Diagnostic use: Range-switch and shift-command diagnosis. Caveat: Manual mode is identified separately by MNL_SW. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Transmission range sensor voltage
items.meaning: Analog input voltage from the transmission range switch/sensor. Diagnostic use: Distinguish mechanical selector adjustment, switch and wiring faults. Caveat: Interpret only together with selector position and the stored position-specific ranges. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Transmission-related DTC count
items.meaning: Count of DTCs recognized by the FN4A-EL diagnostic view. Diagnostic use: Transmission fault summary before retrieving actual TCM/PCM codes. Caveat: Do not substitute SAE 0101 blindly because that count is emission-oriented. Decode status: defined_no_transport.

items.name: Vehicle speed
items.meaning: Vehicle speed used in shift strategy. Diagnostic use: Compare with OSS and commanded gear. Caveat: Standardized physical signal is available. Decode status: exact_standard_alias.

items.name: Vehicle speed at maximum wheel-speed-difference event
items.meaning: Stored vehicle speed at the diagnostic wheel-speed-difference event. Diagnostic use: Event reconstruction. Caveat: SAE vehicle speed is current speed, not the stored event value. Decode status: semantic_fallback.
